card.name: Partway through long English words
card.fires_on: Word pieces inside longer, less common English words, such as encumbrances, inquirers, impingement, incompletely and extinguisher. It often fires after an in- or im- start, before the rest of the word follows.

modes.label: in-/im- words split
modes.description: Pieces within words beginning with in-, im- or enc- that are split mid-word.
modes.example: Source water intakes for coastal desalination can create entrainment concerns with small organisms and imping<<ement>> issues for larger organisms.

modes.label: incomplete- words
modes.description: The start of incom- or Incomplete words, before the ending.
modes.example: untreated or<< incom>>pletely treated varices with bleeding, or

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a long word that is split into pieces, especially words starting with in- or im-.
